# Brønderslev

Brønderslev is a Danish municipality (kommune) listed as part of the health cluster "Klynge NORD" in the AFDK (Atrieflimren i Danmark) program [^src1]. The mention appears in a chapter documenting Indicator 8 (Structured patient education) of the AFDK program, which is administered by Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram and includes a geographic overview of the Danish health clusters participating in the program. Beyond its inclusion in this list, no further details about Brønderslev are available in the corpus.
